top.line: The shop a padel coach could have had for one sleeve: the law, the platforms, Claude, and a vault mock-up.
top.para: Floky's NO STRAIN sleeve costs €32.95 from padel shops that ship to Portugal; sold at €39.90 at the club with the margin shown, it beats ordering one yourself. Portuguese law asks for a registered activity, an invoice per sale, tax on 15% of sales, and consumer rules online; health claims are the trap. A Stripe link with MB WAY costs nothing a month and Shopify has a Claude connector. Claude prepares most of it; accounts, money and refunds stay with the person.

in-short.line: €39.90 at the club, the margin shown, the paperwork real, and Claude running most of it.
in-short.para: The product, the offer, the law, the claims trap, the platforms, what Claude can do, and the mock-up in a vault.

link.line: The link was to Floky's Benelux shop at €41.99; Floky Italy lists it at €35.90.
link.para: Spanish padel shops deliver to mainland Portugal at €32.95 to €35.90 in about two working days. Floky lists two Portuguese stockists, none in the Algarve.

offer.line: Buy five at €32.95, sell at €39.90, a €34.75 margin, cheaper than ordering one yourself.
offer.para: Ordering one yourself costs about €45.85 with delivery. The mock-up has the shop, the message after a lesson, the plan, the setup and the legal page, with payment and delivery as stubs.

law.line: Register the activity, invoice every sale, and know that tax is on 15% of sales, not profit.
law.para: Code 47630, VAT exemption below €15,000 a year, free invoicing from the tax authority, Social Security registration with exemptions, and no one-off route for repeated sales.

consumers.line: Online sales bring a 14-day right to cancel, a three-year guarantee and a complaints book.
consumers.para: The site shows the seller's name, address and tax number and names the Algarve consumer arbitration centre. The seller checks product safety markings as a distributor.

claims.line: Sell it as sportswear: treatment claims would make the seller a medical device manufacturer.
claims.para: Floky's 30.62% figure comes from a study it funded with ten amateur players; no paper was found, and the sleeve is not in the EU medical device database.

employment.line: An employed coach must not compete with the club; anything its shop does not stock is fair game.
employment.para: The labour code lists it among an employee's duties.

platforms.line: A Stripe link at €0 a month to start; Portuguese gateways are cheaper; Shopify when the catalogue grows.
platforms.para: Stripe, the Portuguese gateways and Shopify take MB WAY and Multibanco; Shopify Basic is €19 a month on a yearly plan. Dropshipping exists but keeps the seller responsible. CTT has a small-business logistics plan.

claude.line: Claude writes the shop, creates products and links, and prepares the paperwork.
claude.para: Shopify's connector cannot refund or change payment and tax settings; Stripe's needs restricted agent keys from December 2026. Accounts, money, refunds and the hand-over stay with the person.

limits.line: Not legal or tax advice; prices change; some official pages did not load; Floky did not take part.
limits.para: Single-item delivery costs and Floky's trade terms are not published.

sources.line: Floky, two padel shops, the FIP, Portuguese tax and consumer law, the EU GPSR, Shopify, Stripe, Shopkit.
